London’s new cutest and affordable new bakery! 

@mrsbakery_london is the cutest new bakery in London and I’m definitely a fan. The prices are super low and the bakes are very cute and interesting! Their viral matcha mochi bun is absolutely worth the hype and tastes very indulgent - I’ll definitely be buying it again! They have loads of other sweet and savoury options from cakes to waffles and a load of drinks too!

[LINK IN BIO] We’ve teamed up with yet another lovely local business, ready to well and truly level up lunchtime in London. For one month only, you’ll be able to get your hands on an extra special Secret London sarnie, courtesy of the sandwich aficiona-doughs over at My Favourite Sandwich. 🥪⁠
⁠
The star of the simply scrumptious Secret Sandwich is slow-braised birria beef that’s been marinated for 48 hours and cooked for 24 hours. On top of that you’ll find thinly-sliced pickled red onion, red chilli for a little kick, freshly-picked coriander, and some crushed salty tortilla chips to level up the flavours and add the most satisfying crunch.⁠
⁠
📆 Available 2nd - 30th June at My Favourite Sandwich, 141 Commercial Street, E1 6BJ⁠

We’ve tried the watered-down, the clumpy and the overly sweet. For those who care about the craft, these are the London cafés taking matcha seriously — always thoughtfully whisked and authentically done.

Tag the cafés we’re missing below 👇 

#Matcha #MatchaLatte #London #MatchaLover

This is a hidden gem coffee shop and bakery in London.

It is independently owned with a specialty in oriental tea.

I particularly enjoyed watching the staff making my matcha latte from scratch. It’s so satisfying and the quality of the matcha is lovely. 

In terms of the cakes, the matcha basque cheesecake and sweet potato coconut bread were the highlight of the day.

#londonbaker #londoncafe #asianboy #londonfood #londoneats #foodreview #japanesefood #matcha #londoncoffeeshops #londondesserts #londoncakes #matchalatte #matchacake

This Japanese cafe / bakery is the number one hidden gem in West London. 🇯🇵 🍵💓🌟🔥

You could indulge in the most delicious handmade Japanese style cakes that you’ve ever tasted! With just the right amount of sweetness and freshness to transport your taste buds straight to Japan.

We ordered some of the most delicious matcha with mango and strawberry.

They also offered authentic and beautifully prepared lunch bento boxes, that included handmade origiri rice balls, grilled salmon, salad and warm miso soup.

It was such a simple yet stunning meal to have during the cold weather of London.
